name: bloodtower
description: Bloodtower. Orchestrates its parts under src/: web, server, protocols, e2e.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names server,web --prefix-colors blue,green "DEV_ORIGINS=http://localhost:3000,http://127.0.0.1:3000 pnpm -F bloodtower-server dev" "NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_URL=ws://127.0.0.1:4787/ws pnpm -F bloodtower-web dev"
